## Stable interpretation

- Codex is included across ChatGPT plans, including Free and Go; usage limits vary by plan and task.
- For personal accounts, current official Codex Credits guidance lists Plus and Pro users; personal eligibility and supported features must be checked in Codex Settings > Usage.
- Business, Enterprise, and Edu workspaces with flexible pricing can purchase or use shared workspace credits. For Business, a role with workspace billing permission can purchase or manage them in Workspace settings > Billing; Enterprise and Edu purchase or allocate the shared pool at the contract level, while their Billing is for viewing balances, usage, and controls rather than direct purchase.
- Other organization plans, Codex seats, permissions, and feature availability depend on Usage, workspace Billing, contract terms, and administrator roles.
- Personal ChatGPT Credits and workspace credits are not API Platform balance.
- Personal Plus / Pro accounts are assigned to one actual user and are not shared seats. Teams needing centralized administration, SSO, domain controls, organizational data terms, or an OpenAI contract should compare official Business / Enterprise routes.
- AIXiamo can assist an authorized company with preparing one independent account per named user when the company cannot prepare all accounts itself. Account preparation is not an additional charge; the subscription and confirmed services remain paid. Users must complete any official identity or security steps required by OpenAI and should take control of credentials and 2FA after delivery.
- ChatGPT subscriptions and API Platform billing are separate.
- Codex recommendations depend first on whether the user signs in with ChatGPT or uses an API key.
- Prices, model availability, quotas, and supported payment methods are volatile and must be checked on current official pages.
- The static tool collects no account, password, payment, API key, or token data.
